<think>**Proposing one-hot logic**

**Refining explicit decode logic**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire take_a, take_b, take_c, take_d, take_e;
    wire take_f, take_g, take_h, take_i, take_j;

    // Select A for zero and for every unused select code (10 through 15).
    assign take_a = (~sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1] & ~sel[0]) |
                    (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign take_b = (sel == 4'd1);
    assign take_c = (sel == 4'd2);
    assign take_d = (sel == 4'd3);
    assign take_e = (sel == 4'd4);
    assign take_f = (sel == 4'd5);
    assign take_g = (sel == 4'd6);
    assign take_h = (sel == 4'd7);
    assign take_i = (sel == 4'd8);
    assign take_j = (sel == 4'd9);

    always @(*) begin
        block_out = ({8{take_a}} & block_a) |
                    ({8{take_b}} & block_b) |
                    ({8{take_c}} & block_c) |
                    ({8{take_d}} & block_d) |
                    ({8{take_e}} & block_e) |
                    ({8{take_f}} & block_f) |
                    ({8{take_g}} & block_g) |
                    ({8{take_h}} & block_h) |
                    ({8{take_i}} & block_i) |
                    ({8{take_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths traverse select decoding, fanout buffering, and multiple output-combination stages. The default-to-A behavior can introduce a late default-enable calculation if implemented as the complement of the other nine selections.",
  "rewrite": "Use explicit mutually exclusive data masks and a parallel OR reduction. Express A's enable directly as select zero or sel[3] AND (sel[2] OR sel[1]), avoiding a default enable derived from the other nine decodes. Shared scalar enables serve all eight output bits.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce default-decode depth and improve on the 1.04 ns baseline, but no numerical improvement is established without running the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The implementation uses ten shared enables and eight parallel masked-data reductions. Area should remain comparable to the baseline; mapped area below 1006.089920 um^2 and zero electrical violations still require verification in the specified flow. No storage or additional latency is introduced.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For every two-state input, selects 0 through 9 choose blocks A through J respectively, and selects 10 through 15 choose A. Exactly one enable is asserted for every two-state select. Module name, ports, unsigned widths, and combinational behavior are preserved. Four-state X/Z propagation is not claimed to match the original case statement."
}
